title: It’s been 940 days since my last job
description:
I went to Crafted Seattle by @usertestingofficial to make sure I still know what I’m doing.

After swapping notes with lots of UX designers, design feels more important than ever. AI can speed up the workflow, but the real skill is still bringing human context, lived experience, and better questions into the work.

#uxdesigner #productdesign #craftedseattle #usertestingpartner
